tools.name: deadlines
tools.description: Dates when e-invoicing becomes mandatory, per country (or all countries), each with its official source_url and the date it was checked. Country is a two-letter code such as 'be', 'de', 'ae' or a country name; leave it out for all countries.

tools.name: providers
tools.description: E-invoicing providers we track in a country (two-letter code), alphabetical by product name, with a link to each provider's page. The order never depends on payment; ads and affiliate links are not included.

tools.name: provider
tools.description: Profile of one tracked provider by name or id (for example 'billit'): what it can do, formats, languages, free plan and prices, each price with its source and check date.

tools.name: explain_validation_error
tools.description: Plain-language explanation of a common e-invoice validation rule such as 'BR-CO-10' or 'PEPPOL-EN16931-R120': what it means, usual causes, how to fix it and who fixes it.

tools.name: foreign_supplier_scope
tools.description: Whether a supplier with no establishment in a country must e-invoice there, from our 47-country table: the system, the B2B status and what applies to foreign suppliers, with official sources. Country is a two-letter code or an English name.

tools.name: directory_counts
tools.description: How many businesses are listed in the Peppol network directory, per country, with the change since the last day (source: Peppol Directory (OpenPeppol AISBL)). Country is a two-letter code or 'all'; leave it out for every country.

tools.name: lookup_access_point
tools.description: For a business identifier you give (for example a Belgian company number or a Peppol ID such as 0208:0521875440), find the access-point provider that receives its e-invoices on the Peppol network: provider organisation, SMP host, document types, certificate validity. Provider metadata only. Limited
